description: This file defines a command handler class for creating teller transactions within the Apache Fineract project. It implements an interface for handling commands, uses a service to perform the transaction creation, and includes annotations for dependency injection.

classes.name: CreateTellerTransactionCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing commands to create teller transactions, delegating the creation process to a dedicated service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON commands and delegates to the teller transaction write platform service to create a new teller transaction.
